verdict.rationale: Cline's own docs say you can bring your own API keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, run local models via Ollama/LM Studio, or select from available models through the Cline provider. You can also configure separate models for Plan and Act modes. A community user confirms using Gemini 2.5 rather than being limited to Anthropic, though another notes Ollama works poorly with most models. Missing for 10: a detailed first-party walkthrough of the per-session model-selection UI or CLI flag, and consistent hands-on corroboration of local-provider quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers
